title: Flag Circle Survival 🔴 LIVE – 16 Flags, 1 Hole, Who Survives?
description:
🚩 Flag Circle Survival live 24/7. 16 country flags bounce inside a neon circle, a hole moves around the wall and one flag falls out every few seconds – the last one standing wins.
💬 Tip the winner in the chat (a country name or code like DE, BR, JP). Tip early for more points, build streaks for bonus points and climb the leaderboard.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Watch the flags and pick your survivor.
2. Type the country name or its code in the chat.
3. If your flag survives you score – the earlier your tip, the more points.
4. Type ! and your country (e.g. !india) to get your flag next to your name.

🧩 More live games: youtube.com/channel/UCG6xEYtopZcK66gz_biiIIA/streams

#flagbattle #flagrace #survival #livestream
